summary: Registration form — edit existing registration record
description: Users can open an existing aircraft registration record for editing. The form opens pre-filled with the stored values and submitting triggers an update.

acs.text: Clicking Edit on a registration record opens the registration form pre-filled with all stored field values
Submitting a modified form triggers a PUT request to /api/registrations/{id} with the updated values
On a 200 response, the confirmation banner displays 'Registration updated successfully'
